title: Royal2k delivers a daring, fresh sound to the world on the new song "SIKE U THOT!"
htmlContent:
Canadian-based star, Royal2k is one of the hottest artists in his area and is currently making waves with his recent song "SIKE U THOT!". His talents shine bright as he releases his highly infectious sound for fans to enjoy.

Royal2k delivers a daring, fresh sound to the world on the new song "SIKE U THOT!". "SIKE U THOT!" is a high-energy track that gives his audience confidence with themes of never wanting to fall in love and feeling too good for anybody. The Track wastes little time getting you invested with a high-energy production that is engaging and layered in creativity to make music like you haven't heard before.
